join_policy: Candidate records share mechanisms or conversion gaps; they are not person-, firm-, place-, or event-level joins.

candidates.title: Formal response arrives before usable recovery
candidates.mechanism: formal output -> implementation gap -> repeated effort, waiting, residual loss, or non-use
candidates.counter_signal: Some cases reach payment, continued work, restoration, or improved access.
candidates.next_comparison: Code the same remedy, implementation, receipt, recovery, and exit stages across labor, consumer, health, and public-service records.

lineage_review.assessment: Seven distinct primary artifacts are identifiable: four separate Fair Work Commission cases, one Fair Work Ombudsman enforcement follow-up, one GSMA report, and one British Social Attitudes report. Generic FWC navigation URLs are repeated but are not counted as primary artifacts.
lineage_review.remaining: Publisher-level independence, shared datasets, and underlying study lineage still require review.

coverage.interpretation: Distinct hosts and URLs are discovery coverage, not proof of independent confirmation; publisher lineage and shared source material still require review.

candidates.title: Time and financial pressure reduce practical room before demand disappears
candidates.mechanism: material or care pressure -> hidden time price and coordination work -> substitution, delayed completion, or unequal participation
candidates.counter_signal: Flexible schedules, paid support, community infrastructure, or higher resources can preserve participation.
candidates.next_comparison: Keep participant and total-population denominators separate and distinguish nominal spending from quantities, access, and wellbeing.

lineage_review.assessment: Eight source sets are identifiable: ABS Time Use Survey tables, Colombia DANE ENUT, EIGE CARE Survey, England DHSC SACE, ABS General Social Survey, ANZ/Roy Morgan Consumer Confidence, 4Culture/Wilkening Culture and Communities, and the JPMorganChase Institute household liquidity snapshot.
lineage_review.remaining: The ABS tables within one record are one survey, JPMorganChase is a single endpoint with a restrictive republication notice, and cross-country survey definitions and causal comparability remain open.

coverage.interpretation: Distinct hosts and URLs are discovery coverage, not proof of independent confirmation; publisher lineage and shared source material still require review.

candidates.title: Digital capability expands while control and trust remain contested
candidates.mechanism: capability or convenience -> delegated control and platform dependency -> trust, portability, explanation, or correction gap
candidates.counter_signal: Delegation can be preferred when stakes are low and control, human review, or switching remain credible.
candidates.next_comparison: Separate task efficiency from later correction, retention, switching, and institutional legitimacy.

lineage_review.assessment: Seven primary source sets are identifiable: Accenture Consumer Pulse, Assurant Connected Consumer Trends, Deloitte Digital Media Trends, DIMA/MusicWatch streaming research, OECD AI markets, the INFORMS field experiment, and BCG Digital Government Citizen Survey.
lineage_review.remaining: OECD DOI and web page are one artifact; the HBS summary is a secondary representation of the INFORMS paper; DIMA depends on MusicWatch; survey sponsorship and method comparability remain open.

coverage.interpretation: Distinct hosts and URLs are discovery coverage, not proof of independent confirmation; publisher lineage and shared source material still require review.

candidates.title: Infrastructure dependency becomes cultural and geopolitical power
candidates.mechanism: capacity or ownership concentration -> dependency and unequal access -> local burden, public legitimacy, resilience, or state leverage
candidates.counter_signal: Redundancy, public governance, open access, local benefits, and credible substitutes can create shared capacity.
candidates.next_comparison: Link operation, actual user receipt, local incidence, maintenance, and later behavior; announced capacity is not reliable benefit.

lineage_review.assessment: Seven source sets are identifiable: PJM/DOE/FERC large-load reliability materials for one operating event, USCC trans-Pacific cable research, OECD Space Economy, Africa Sustainable Development Report, OECD/EU Social Economy in Europe, IRENA Renewable Capacity Statistics, and World Bank cloud-procurement guidance.
lineage_review.remaining: PJM materials are one event with multiple documents; OECD/EU pages are one report; guidance and modeled risks are not observed user outcomes. Cross-source comparability remains open.

coverage.interpretation: Distinct hosts and URLs are discovery coverage, not proof of independent confirmation; publisher lineage and shared source material still require review.
